_notes: Source: packets/video_motion.txt (805 lines, all read), full threads 44088216, 29634114, 13543927, 37133128, 39930493, 33886673, 46732672, 48468095, plus an ontopic.json grep for mogrt / essential graphics / lower third / nexrender / extendscript / after effects template / remotion / hyperframes / motion canvas / expressions. mention_count is the number of distinct packet comments whose text names the tool, after removing name collisions: Lottie.org the care-home company, people named Lottie, Remotion the 2020-22 video-chat app, and a repeated freelancer signature. It is approximate and inflated by repeated hiring and freelancer posts, mainly for Framer Motion and Lottie. The ontopic grep added about 45 more on-topic Remotion stories that are not counted here. recommend_count is a hand count of distinct comments that read as an endorsement from use. nexrender has zero hits. MOGRT, Essential Graphics and ExtendScript have almost no discussion on HN.

tools.what_it_does: JSON vector-animation format, originally an After Effects export via Bodymovin, with runtime players for web, iOS, Android, RN, Skia/ThorVG; now governed by the Lottie Animation Community (Linux Foundation).

recommended_for.claim: Replaces multi-MB PNG sequences/GIFs with KB-sized resolution-independent JSON
Closes the animator-to-developer handoff gap; one AE animator's work ships natively
PBS KIDS uses it for brand animations: one AE artist exports Lottie JSON for apps/games, MOV for broadcast and YouTube, and simplified SVG for low-end devices from the same source
Used for brand logo/hero animations on marketing sites (Stephen Hawking site logo, Webflow ecommerce hero)
Health/patient-education animation: a doctor's breathing app and a patient-education series built with AE + Lottie
Transparency/alpha overlays are its best feature vs video
Runtime-editable text enables localisation without shipping many assets
Data-driven 'wrapped'-style recap by addressing AE layers by name at runtime (works, but needed an extra library)
Best export target if a cloud animation tool shuts down (preserves vectors)

criticisms.claim: Most AE features are unsupported and AE gives no warning, so animators must author within limits from scratch
Player/runtime weight (65kB to 250kB+) and bundle bloat hurt web performance/Lighthouse
JSON is a poor, unreadable format; dynamic manipulation is near-impossible
Tied to expensive proprietary After Effects; designers lack AE skills so it goes unused
Hard to maintain; every UI change needs an AE person
Teams reverted to MP4/WebM or animated WebP instead
Rendering differs across the separate Airbnb players
CPU hog in browser; rlottie unsafe for untrusted files
Rendering Lottie to other formats is awkward (tools screenshot Chromium, breaking transparency)

tools.strongest_criticism: You cannot take an existing After Effects project and convert it, because about 95% of AE features are off-limits and AE gives no feedback when you overstep, so an artist has to author from scratch within Lottie's limits (44090280).

tools.what_it_does: After Effects extension that exports compositions to Lottie JSON (also experimental AVD/SMIL exporters).

recommended_for.claim: Simple to use: AE animation into a React app in about 15 minutes
Go-to, most reliable way to get keyframe animation out of AE for the web
bodymovin-to-smil gives JS-free SVG animation for above-the-fold content

criticisms.claim: AVD exporter extremely beta, undocumented subset; SMIL converter poorly maintained

tools.strongest_criticism: Lottie Android's author said the Bodymovin-to-AVD plugin is extremely beta and supports only a subset of AE features and none of Lottie's own, such as setting progress or dynamic properties (17211833).

tools.what_it_does: LottieFiles' zipped superset of Lottie that bundles multiple animations and assets and adds theming, state machines, and a Rust/ThorVG cross-platform player.

recommended_for.claim: Bundles animations and assets, so it is easier to keep out of the JS bundle and serve from a CDN

criticisms.claim: Web player WASM is about 308-326 KB, not the 16 KB people assumed

tools.strongest_criticism: The dotLottie web player loads about 308 KB of WASM in addition to roughly 18 KB of JS (39936156).

Figma to Lottie plugin

Closest modern Flash replacement

Not an AE pipeline; less artistic drawing tools; text support came late

articles_fetched.summary: The Lottie Animation Community, a non-profit project hosted by the Linux Foundation under the Joint Development Foundation, is formalizing a Lottie spec. The page admits some features used by current players are still outside the spec. AE plus a plugin remains the common authoring path, and dotLottie (.lottie) is described as a separate LottieFiles archive format.

Lottielab pitches a collaborative browser editor for product teams, with fast Figma and After Effects import, free templates and 1:1 Lottie playback across iOS, Android and web. Its tools convert to dotLottie, GIF, MP4 and WebM and include hosting. The homepage says nothing about brand theming or variables.

HyperFrames (Apache 2.0, from HeyGen) turns HTML files with timing data-attributes into deterministic MP4. It animates via GSAP, CSS, Lottie or Three.js and renders through headless Chrome and FFmpeg, locally, in Docker or on Lambda. It ships agent skills, a block catalog that includes captions and overlays, and a 'frame.md' that converts a brand's design system into a form suitable for video.
